source: lz-live probe --plan-only of tests/live/probes/alerting in the owner clone at the reviewed commit (evidence/T084.md, Live re-run); the run record .local/live/<run id>/leftovers.json and listings/*.json, written through the run's redactor; plan only, nothing created, cost 0. Committed by T065.

anonymised.method: ~/.local/share/ovh-lz/review/t065-anonymise.py <run dir> <this dir>: every UUID, 32-hex id, account handle (<letters><digits>-ovh) and e-mail replaced by a fixed fake value, the same original always by the same fake; the redactor's [REDACTED] marker becomes the fake client id; structure, field names, types and value shapes kept; the script fails if an original value survives

values.what: public cloud project id (32 hex), also inside its URN and the listing paths of leftovers.json
account handle (policy owner, account resource URN, identity URNs)
id of the lz-sandbox-admin IAM policy (the admin exemption's policy id)
id of the ovh-default IAM policy
resource group id in the ovh-default policy
lz-sandbox-admin OAuth2 client id, already [REDACTED] by the run's redactor (clientId and the oauth2-<client id> identity URN; believed the same value)

anonymised.kept: resource names (lz-sandbox-admin, ovh-default, ADMIN, DEFAULT, UNPRIVILEGED: names the project or OVHcloud chose, no personal data), descriptions, actions, timestamps, region names; no e-mail occurs in the committed files (the run's plan, which holds one, is not committed)

ovh_cloud_project_storage.note: []: the record is written only after a successful listing (leftovers.go record), so at least one region of the project's list answered an empty array; the eight regions named in leftovers.json answered 404

ovh_cloud_project_network_private_subnet.note: child of a network; the project has none, so no subnet listing was asked; owed from the first resource-creating run (T010)

ovh_cloud_project_user_s3_credential.note: child of a user; none exists; owed from T010

ovh_cloud_project_user_s3_policy.note: child of a user; none exists; owed from T010

ovh_me_api_oauth2_client.note: one client, the admin; the record holds clientId and name only (what the parser reads)

ovh_me_identity_group.note: three default groups; the record holds name only

ovh_iam_resource_tags.note: the project's IAM resource answered without a tags field (leftovers.json), so nothing was recorded; a tagged answer is owed from T010

ovh_cloud_project_alerting.note: the id list was empty (no file, no error), so no alert was asked; owed from T010

ovh_cloud_quota.note: a property of the project, nothing to list

ovh_cloud_project.note: the adopted project, exempt by id

replay._note: Answers the run asked for but did not record, derived from the record and shaped by the API schema; {p} is the project id. An entry with from is the captured listing file served as one page; the OAuth2 client and identity group records are served by the test as the id list plus one detail answer per element (TestLeftoversCaptured).

/cloud/project/{p}/region.provenance: derived: the eight names from leftovers.json's storage errors; S3-UNNAMED stands for the region(s) whose storage listing answered [] (name not in the record); order not recorded

/cloud/project/{p}/region/BHS5.provenance: not captured: cloud.Region (kb/api/v1/cloud.json:67596); services UNVERIFIED, chosen without an Object Storage service because the storage listing answered 404

/cloud/project/{p}/region/S3-UNNAMED.provenance: not captured: cloud.Region shape; the service name storage-s3-standard is UNVERIFIED (the qualifying evidence is the next live run's recorded region details)

/cloud/project/{p}/alerting.provenance: derived: no alerting record and no alerting error, so the id list parsed and was empty

/iam/resource/urn:v1:eu:resource:publicC.provenance: derived: the answer parsed as an object without a tags field (leftovers.json); other fields iam.resource.Resource (kb/api/v2/iam.json:2624), values not captured
